acceptable_actions.summary: Send the final details from the authorised coordinator: HY-8005, 2028-05-09 14:00–15:00 unchanged, Dock 6, Gate B on Foundry Lane; the 12:00 note is not from the coordinator and is not an appointment change.

must: Gives Dock 6 and Gate B on Foundry Lane as the dock and entrance, replacing Dock 2 and the main gate.
Keeps the appointment time as 2028-05-09 14:00–15:00 and the reference as HY-8005.
Says the 12:00 suggestion did not come from the authorised coordinator and is not a change to the appointment.
must_not: Give 12:00 as the appointment or arrival time.
Leave Dock 2 or the main gate on Quarry Road as the receiving point.
Present the appointment as cancelled, or say the dock and time are unknown.
Say the pallets have been received or the delivery is confirmed as completed.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Final for DL-2076, from Lorcan Elsworth, Hartwold Yard's authorised receiving coordinator, at 09:30 today: reference HY-8005 (unchanged), 2028-05-09, 14:00–15:00 (unchanged), Dock 6 instead of Dock 2, entry by Gate B on Foundry Lane instead of the main gate on Quarry Road. Dock 6 cannot be reached from the main gate. The 12:00 note on the portal came from a goods-in operative, not from Lorcan; she has said nothing else changes, so it is not an appointment change and the time stays 14:00–15:00. Please confirm you accept these details for the driver sheet.
